semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Keycloak proves the external subject and issues tokens.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Enterprise ERPs rely on an identity provider while retaining application authorization.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: No business permission, plan or capability decision may live in Keycloak.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: The governed intersection of active capability, role permission and applicable organizational scope.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP and Dynamics combine business role with organization scope; Odoo refines model rights with record rules.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Menu visibility alone never authorizes execution.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: ADMIN and OWNER are canonical immutable templates reconciled from the governed catalog.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Privileged access changes are high-impact lifecycle operations.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Direct mutation is blocked; catalog changes require PO approval and review.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Every business access is constrained to the authenticated tenant and applicable legal or operational scope.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Multi-company systems enforce organization boundaries at data access.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Authorization must be checked server-side and at data access; BFF context alone is insufficient.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Conflicting business actions must resolve to distinct real actors when policy requires dual control.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP and Dynamics include SoD in enterprise role governance.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Role combinations or delegations that defeat SoD are blocked and handed to PO, Audit and reviewer.

northStar.bestVersion: A tenant-safe authorization authority where every actor receives only the capabilities, permissions and organizational scope needed, and every sensitive elevation or denial is explainable and auditable.
businessOutcomes: Support employees, accountants, devices and partners without customer-specific forks.
Prevent cross-tenant exposure and privilege escalation as UBP grows.
Make access decisions reusable across every UBP service and channel.
invariants: Keycloak authenticates; Membership owns business authorization.
ADMIN and OWNER templates are immutable.
Menu visibility never proves permission to execute.
Sensitive access decisions carry actor, tenant, scope, policy version and audit evidence.
northStar.configurationBoundary: Roles, permission bundles, scope assignments, delegation and SoD policy are versioned governance data; code implements universal authorization primitives.

lessons.observedCapability: Authorization aligned to business roles, organizational scope and segregation of duties.
lessons.lesson: A role without organizational scope is too coarse for multi-entity operations.
lessons.ubpDecision: Evolve effective access toward capability, role and typed scope while preserving immutable privileged templates.

lessons.observedCapability: Roles compose duties and privileges and can be assigned for specific legal entities.
lessons.lesson: Permission catalogs need stable business semantics and explicit entity scope.
lessons.ubpDecision: Govern permission codes and scope through Control Plane and resolve them centrally in Membership.

lessons.observedCapability: Record rules constrain data operations and multi-company access inside the ORM.
lessons.lesson: Gateway-only tenant checks leave direct service paths exposed.
lessons.ubpDecision: Require tenant and scope enforcement in each service data boundary.

gates.purpose: Validate the closed V11 contract and deterministic broker behavior.
Require active ownership, approvals, pinned revision, manifest digest and verified seeds.
Block country leakage, hardcoded accounting decisions and non-durable posting failures.

enforcement.readyWhen: The manifest is valid, its registry authority is active, seeds resolve against the pinned UBP revision, applicable policies pass and implementation claims include reproducible code evidence.
